title: General Power Of Attorney By A Person Going Abroad To Authorise All Acts On His Behalf
description: A general power of attorney by a person going abroad to authorise all acts on his behalf used for authorization documents granting legal authority to act on behalf of another. Suitable for principals granting power, or attorneys receiving authority to act. Key details required: Date, Name (Son of), Name, Signatory Name.
description_hi: General Power Of Attorney By A Person Going Abroad To Authorise All Acts On His Behalf — दूसरे की ओर से कार्य करने का कानूनी अधिकार देने वाले प्राधिकरण दस्तावेज के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। शक्ति प्रदान करने वाले प्रधान, या कार्य करने का अधिकार प्राप्त करने वाले अधिवक्ता के लिए उपयुक्त। 4 आवश्यक और 2 वैकल्पिक विवरण भरने होंगे।
